title: AI Engineer - II
description:
**Our Company:**
----------------


At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.


**What You’ll Do**
------------------


We are looking for an Artificial Intelligence Engineer (II) to design, build, evaluate, and improve AI capabilities for enterprise data and database systems. You will work across AI/ML, vector search, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and production software engineering, helping build scalable AI capabilities for Teradata’s enterprise customers.


In this role, you will contribute to end\-to\-end AI solutions that operate across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will work closely with experienced AI engineers and architects to develop production\-ready capabilities that integrate AI with enterprise data and the Teradata platform.


You will:


* Design and implement AI/ML capabilities and intelligent applications for enterprise data and database workloads.
* Develop and enhance vector search and retrieval capabilities, including algorithms and techniques such as HNSW, IVF, Flat search, Product Quantization (PQ), and other vector indexing and quantization approaches.
* Develop Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Agentic RAG solutions that combine enterprise data, vector search, large language models (LLMs), APIs, tools, and contextual information.
* Build components for AI agents and agentic workflows, including tool invocation, structured outputs, context management, MCP\-based integrations, and multi\-step workflows.
* Develop AI capabilities using Python, C\+\+, Rust, or similar programming languages, with a focus on performance, scalability, maintainability, and platform independence.
* Build software that can operate across AWS, Azure, GCP, on\-premises, and hybrid environments, minimizing dependencies on any specific cloud platform.
* Apply software engineering best practices including unit testing, integration testing, code reviews, observability, security, documentation, and performance optimization.
* Work with senior engineers and architects to translate product requirements and customer use cases into technical designs, implementation plans, and production\-quality software.
* Contribute to technical investigations, prototypes, proof\-of\-concepts, and new AI capabilities as the technology and product landscape evolves.
* Continuously learn and apply emerging developments in Generative AI, LLMs, vector databases, agentic AI, information retrieval, model optimization, and AI engineering.

**Who You’ll Work With**
------------------------


You will work as part of a collaborative Artificial Intelligence Engineering team building foundational AI capabilities for Teradata’s enterprise data platform.


You’ll work closely with:


* AI Architects and Senior AI Engineers to design scalable AI architectures and solve complex technical problems.
* ML/AI Engineers and Software Engineers to implement vector search, RAG, agentic AI, and database\-integrated AI capabilities.
* Database and Platform Engineering teams to integrate AI functionality with Teradata database technologies and core platform services.
* Product Managers and UX teams to understand customer requirements and translate use cases into practical AI capabilities.

You will work in a highly collaborative environment where engineers are expected to learn quickly, take ownership, contribute technically, and work across multiple areas of AI engineering.


**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate / Minimum Requirements**
---------------------------------------------------------------


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 3\+ years of professional software engineering, AI/ML, or data engineering experience, with hands\-on development experience.
* Strong programming experience in at least one of C\+\+, Python, Rust, Java, or a similar programming language.
* Experience building or integrating AI/ML, NLP, Generative AI, or LLM\-based applications.
* Understanding of machine learning concepts, embeddings, information retrieval, vector search, and similarity search.
* Experience working with SQL, relational databases, structured data, or database\-integrated applications.
* Experience developing software using APIs, microservices, SDKs, or distributed systems concepts.
* Understanding of software engineering fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented/design principles, testing, debugging, and version control.
* Ability to analyze technical problems, investigate failures, and develop robust and maintainable solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and cross\-functional teams.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------


* Hands\-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, or AI application development.
* Familiarity with vector databases, vector indexes, embeddings, similarity search, or approximate nearest\-neighbor (ANN) algorithms.
* Exposure to technologies such as HNSW, IVF, Product Quantization, or other vector search/optimization techniques.
* Experience with frameworks or technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, agent frameworks, embedding models, vector databases, or similar AI frameworks.
* Experience working with structured and unstructured data ingestion and retrieval pipelines.
* Experience developing applications that run across multiple cloud platforms or cloud\-agnostic environments is a plus.
* Understanding of AI observability, evaluation, testing, reliability, security, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Linux, REST APIs, or distributed systems is a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with the ability to work through ambiguous technical problems and learn new technologies quickly.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative engineering environment and take ownership of assigned technical deliverables from design through implementation and validation.
* A strong interest in keeping current with rapidly evolving AI/ML and Generative AI technologies and applying them to real\-world enterprise problems.

\#LI\-NM1


Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

What sets Eightfold apart is not just our technology and mission, but our people. We are a deeply technical, execution\-driven organization that values ownership, collaboration, and high standards. Our teams work closely across functions and locations to build systems that scale in real\-world enterprise environments.
  
  

**About the role :** Eightfold is building the AI platform that powers talent decisions for enterprises worldwide. As our Test Architect, you own the overall quality of what we ship — across a complex, multi\-tenant SaaS platform and the AI models and copilots at its core. This is a hands\-on architecture role: you'll set the quality strategy, build the frameworks and guardrails that teams test against, and pioneer how we assure AI systems — from deep\-learning matching models to generative\-AI agents — at production scale. You won't just catch defects; you'll design the system that makes quality inevitable.
  
  

What you'll own;
  
Product quality strategy
  
  

Define and drive the end\-to\-end test architecture, standards, and quality strategy across all products and services.
  
Own the test strategy across layers — unit, API/contract, integration, UI, end\-to\-end — and the frameworks teams build on.
  
Design quality gates into CI/CD so quality shifts left; make "green build \= releasable" true and trustworthy.
  
**Lead non\-functional testing:** performance and scalability, reliability/resilience, security, and data quality across a high\-volume, multi\-tenant system.
  
Build test data management and environment strategy for a platform handling sensitive candidate and employee data.
  
Define the quality metrics that matter (coverage, escape rate, flakiness, MTTR, release confidence) and hold the org to them.
  
Mentor and raise the bar for SDETs and QA engineers; influence engineering\-wide quality culture without needing authority.
  
  

AI quality \& assurance
  
  

Own quality for LLM\-powered copilots and agents — groundedness/hallucination checks, prompt and output regression, guardrail and safety testing, and red\-teaming.
  
**Drive AI\-accelerated testing:** AI\-generated test cases, self\-healing automation, intelligent test triage and coverage analysis, and synthetic test\-data generation — using AI to make the whole QA function faster and smarter.
  
  

What we're looking for;
  
  

Bachelors Degree in Engineering (B.E/B.Tech in computer science or related discipline is preferred)
  
3\+ years in software quality/engineering ,owning quality at platform scale.
  
Deep automation expertise — strong coding ability in one or more of Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript, and frameworks like Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar; solid API/contract testing.
  
Proven design of test architecture and CI/CD quality gates (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) in cloud\-native environments (AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes).
  
Strength in non\-functional testing — performance/load (k6, JMeter, Gatling, or similar), reliability, and security fundamentals.
  
Experience testing data\- or ML\-driven systems, or a clear track record of ramping fast into new technical domains and a genuine pull toward AI quality.
  
The judgment and influence to set standards across many teams, and the communication to make quality a shared goal, not a gate.
  
Strong problem solving and analytical skills
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  
Ability to work independently and within a team structure
  
  

Bonus points
  
  

Hands\-on experience building LLM/GenAI evaluations (RAG evaluation, prompt regression, LLM\-as\-judge, eval frameworks) or testing ML pipelines and model performance.
  
**Familiarity with responsible\-AI concepts:** bias/fairness metrics, model explainability, AI governance.
  
Enterprise multi\-tenant SaaS background; HR\-tech or other regulated/high\-compliance domains a plus.

title: Principal Consultant - Aquatic Design
description:
WSP is seeking an exceptional Principal Consultant to lead and grow our Aquatic \& Wellness design discipline from our Global Capability Centre (GCC). This is a uniquely integrated role that combines senior design leadership with full technical project delivery and is central to our strategic ambition of building an independently capable, India\-based delivery team.  



  

In this role, you will drive the complete lifecycle of aquatic and wellness projects — from early pre\-concept and concept design through schematic design, technical production, and final delivery. You will bring both a strong design sensibility and engineering rigour, leading visual narratives, 3D models, and design documentation while simultaneously owning project delivery, quality assurance, and team performance.  



  

This position is pivotal to WSP’s long\-term goal of enabling the India GCC to operate as a fully self\-sufficient delivery hub for Aquatic \& Wellness projects globally. You will play a founding role in building that capability, including mentoring junior team members, establishing robust workflows, and working progressively toward independent end\-to\-end project ownership from India. You will exercise independent judgment on complex and ambiguous technical matters, manage multidisciplinary collaboration across geographies, and serve as the discipline’s senior representative.


  
BIM LEADERSHIP
  

* Lead the design process across all phases: from pre\-concept, concept, and schematic stages through to technical design and delivery, ensuring a clear, consistent design direction throughout.
* Develop and lead design narratives, articulating design intent through presentations, documentation, and client\-facing materials.
* Create and direct visuals including mood boards, user journeys, diagrams, spatial compositions, and 3D models that evolve alongside project needs.
* Lead the preparation of complete concept design packages in alignment with WSP standards and client expectations.
* Apply a strong eye for detail, colour, materials, and spatial composition to ensure experiential quality across all design outputs.
* Contribute meaningfully to later design stages by developing and refining plans, sections, and critical architectural details in CAD, Revit, and BIM workflows.
TECHNICAL DESIGN DELIVERY
  

* Take full ownership of aquatic and wellness design projects, applying deep technical knowledge across swimming pool, water feature, and spa/wellness systems.
* Actively participate in the production, review, and approval of design documentation, drawings, and models, maintaining a strong focus on quality, constructability, and sustainability.
* Lead the analysis and resolution of complex, multi\-variable technical challenges, exercising independent professional judgement on the optimal course of action.
* Uphold QA/QC processes throughout the full design lifecycle, including direct contribution to technical outputs where required.
* Ensure technical outputs meet relevant international and local codes, standards, and industry best practices.
PRODUCTION \& DIGITAL DELIVERY
  

* Lead the development of 2D and 3D models from early concept stages through to detailed architectural documentation.
* Develop digital massing models, visualisations, and diagrams for client presentations and internal reviews.
* Manage and enforce organised model structures, layer conventions, and naming standards to support efficient team collaboration.
* Prepare well\-structured drawing packages across concept, schematic, and downstream documentation phases.
* Lead the assembly of comprehensive design documentation — plans, sections, elevations, renders, and diagrams — ensuring graphic quality reflects design intent at every stage.
* Ensure all digital deliverables comply with WSP’s internal delivery standards, templates, and naming conventions.
PROJECT COORDINATION \& STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT
  

* Manage technical resources, workflows, and project timelines to ensure efficient and on\-time delivery.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (architecture, engineering, MEP, planning, and specialty consultants) across geographies to integrate technical and design requirements.
* Interface with clients and stakeholders, providing technical input and addressing project requirements with confidence and clarity.
* Represent the discipline in meetings, workshops, and presentations, resolving technical queries and communicating design decisions effectively.
* Coordinate with WSP’s global Aquatic \& Wellness teams to ensure the India GCC contributes to, and progressively leads, project delivery

TEAM LEADERSHIP \& MENTORING
  

* Supervise and mentor junior designers, BIM technicians, and production staff, supporting their professional development and alignment with WSP standards.
* Operate with significant autonomy and minimal supervision, setting the objectives, pace, and working approach for the India Aquatic \& Wellness team.
* Lead teams in developing new methods, techniques, and analytical frameworks to address significant technical and operational challenges.
* Contribute to resource planning, workload forecasting, and the development of internal processes and delivery procedures.
* Support the Head of Discipline in establishing and continuously enhancing operational excellence.
PROCESS DEVELOPMENT \& INNOVATION
  

* Lead initiatives to enhance design workflows, digital delivery processes, and documentation standards across the team.
* Develop internal design templates, libraries, and graphic assets to ensure consistent, high\-quality project output.
* Explore and champion new tools, techniques, and digital methods, including AIassisted visualisation, parametric modelling, and BIM workflows, to advance design and delivery capability.
* Document and share lessons learned and best practices, supporting continuous improvement within the India team.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, creative curiosity, and continuous innovation.
STRATEGIC GOAL: INDEPENDENT INDIA\-BASED DELIVERY
  

This is the defining objective of this role. The Principal Consultant will be the cornerstone of WSP’s ambition to establish the India GCC as a world\-class, fully self\-sufficient delivery centre for Aquatic \& Wellness design.
  

* Progressively take ownership of full project delivery, from client brief and concept through to construction documentation, managed and delivered entirely from India.
* Establish the workflows, quality frameworks, and team capabilities necessary for end\-to\-end independent delivery.
* Build, develop, and retain a high\-performing India\-based design and technical team capable of handling complex international projects.
* Collaborate with the Head of Aquatic Design to define milestones and a roadmap for transitioning projects to full India\-led delivery.
* Serve as the primary point of accountability for project delivery quality, efficiency, and client satisfaction from the India GCC.
* Act as an ambassador for the India team’s capability, building trust with global stakeholders and demonstrating that world\-class aquatic design can be delivered from India.

  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum 12–15\+ years of progressive experience in the design and delivery of aquatic and wellness projects, including swimming pools, water features, and spa environments.
* Demonstrated experience spanning both design (concept, schematic, design development) and technical delivery (documentation, coordination, QA/QC, construction support).
* Prior experience in a consulting or design\-build environment, ideally with exposure to international projects and multidisciplinary teams.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
  

* Advanced proficiency in 2D/3D design software including AutoCAD, Revit, Rhino, Grasshopper, or similar platforms.
* Proficiency in BIM workflows and collaboration tools such as BIM360\.
* High proficiency in graphic presentation tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator).
* Exceptional visualisation and representation abilities including diagrams, sketches, and digital modelling.
* Strong understanding of relevant international and local design codes, standards, and best practices for aquatic and wellness environments.
LEADERSHIP \& INTERPERSONAL SKILLS
  

* Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor teams, with experience managing geographically distributed or multidisciplinary groups.
* Confident presenter and communicator, able to articulate complex design and technical ideas clearly to clients, stakeholders, and internal teams.
* Strong coordination and integration skills across architecture, engineering, MEP, and specialist disciplines.
* Ability to operate with significant autonomy, exercising sound judgement on complex and ambiguous matters.
* Curiosity and drive to explore emerging tools, techniques, and digital methods (e.g., AI\-assisted design, parametric workflows).
* Passion for design excellence, continuous improvement, and building highperforming teams.
* Professional licensure (e.g., CEng, P.Eng) is preferred but not essential.

description:
**Job Description**  

We are looking for a motivated and hands\-on **Senior Software Engineer** to join the CRONUS Platform Team and strengthen the Identity module for Portfolio Brands. The role will focus on building secure, reliable and scalable backend services that support customer registration, login, authentication, authorization and personal\-data protection.


You will work with engineers, product managers, architects, security specialists and business stakeholders to improve Customer Identity and Access Management capabilities across Weekday, COS, ARKET and \&Other Stories. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, deployment, monitoring and production support.


This is a long\-term strategic role with strong ownership. Over time, there will be opportunities to take broader technical leadership responsibilities within the team.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and deliver secure customer identity capabilities and production\-grade backend services.


Key responsibilities include:

* Design, build and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
* Develop and improve customer identity journeys, including registration, sign\-in, password reset, account recovery, multi\-factor authentication and social login.
* Integrate backend services with Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID and other customer identity platforms.
* Implement secure authentication and authorization using OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect and token\-based security.
* Build reliable APIs and integrations for customer profile, consent, newsletter and related customer capabilities.
* Protect customer and personal data through secure design, access controls, privacy\-aware data handling and appropriate operational controls.
* Design services for scalability, reliability, performance and maintainability.
* Improve observability through effective logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing and alerts.
* Own services across the full lifecycle, including automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, production support and continuous improvement.
* Investigate technical issues and production incidents, identify root causes and implement long\-term improvements.
* Collaborate with security, architecture, product and engineering teams to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
* Review code, support engineering standards, mentor colleagues and communicate technical risks and trade\-offs clearly.
* Contribute to the future evolution of the CIAM landscape, including the adoption of new identity platforms such as Strivacity.

**WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH**


The CRONUS Platform Team is part of Portfolio Brands Tech and supports the digital commerce platform used by Weekday, COS, ARKET and \&Other Stories. The team owns shared platform capabilities that help the brands deliver stable, secure and reliable customer experiences.


The Platform Team works across five capability areas:

* **Backend Engineering:** Shared backend services and system\-to\-system integration services.
* **Site Reliability Engineering:** Reliability, availability, monitoring, alerts and performance engineering.
* **Automation:** Quality automation using Playwright and process automation using RPA.
* **Operations:** Incident management, problem management and platform stability.
* **Security \& Compliance:** Security engineering, audits and compliance.


You will work mainly within Backend Engineering and the Identity module, while collaborating closely with SRE, operations, automation, security and other product teams. The team values end\-to\-end ownership, open communication, shared learning and practical solutions that improve customer experience and business reliability.

**WHO YOU ARE**


We are looking for someone with strong backend engineering and customer identity experience, along with a collaborative and ownership\-driven mindset.

* **Overall Experience:** 8\-10 years of relevant software engineering experience, including designing, developing, testing and operating backend applications or services.
* **Java:** Strong and recent hands\-on experience with Java 17\+ and core Java concepts, including object\-oriented design, collections, exception handling, concurrency and clean code.
* **Spring Boot:** Practical experience building production\-grade REST APIs and microservices using Spring Boot and the wider Spring ecosystem.
* **IAM / CIAM:** Meaningful hands\-on experience with customer identity and access management, including authentication, authorization, user identity, access control, identity journeys, customer profiles, consent and personal\-data protection.
* **Azure B2C:** Experience with Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID or a comparable CIAM platform. You should understand user flows or policies, registration, MFA, social identity providers, tokens and backend integration.
* **Identity Standards:** Good understanding of OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and token lifecycle management.
* **Backend Engineering:** Strong experience with API design, microservices, secure coding, databases, system integrations, performance, reliability and production support.
* **Cloud \& Containers:** Experience with cloud\-native development, Docker and Kubernetes. Azure experience is preferred.
* **CI/CD:** Experience with automated build, test and deployment pipelines.
* **Databases:** Practical experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, for example PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB.
* **Testing:** Experience with unit, integration, contract, security and performance testing.
* **Observability:** Experience with logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing and production alerting.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with event\-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus or similar technologies.
* Experience migrating between customer identity platforms or modernizing an existing CIAM solution.
* Exposure to Strivacity or another modern customer identity platform.
* Experience working with customer consent, preference or newsletter capabilities.
* Experience in e\-commerce or another high\-traffic customer\-facing digital platform.

**And people who are**

* Passionate about secure, reliable and simple customer experiences.
* Comfortable taking ownership and moving complex work from problem to production.
* Collaborative team players who work well in global, cross\-functional environments.
* Proactive problem\-solvers who balance technical quality with practical delivery.
* Able to explain technical choices, risks and trade\-offs in clear language.
* Interested in mentoring colleagues and growing into broader technical leadership responsibilities.

Help us re\-imagine fashion and together we will re\-shape our industry. Learn more about H\&M here.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  


**About our Team**  

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** that power a global travel platform serving **millions of users daily**. We own mission\-critical domains across **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**.



Our systems run with **high availability, low latency, and zero\-downtime expectations**, powered by modern technologies such as **Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**, along with strong foundations in **CI/CD, automation, and observability**.



We ship fast—often **dozens of releases a day**—and design systems that are **resilient, self\-healing, and built to scale globally**.

  

**The Opportunity**  

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end\-to\-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade\-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands\-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

  

**What You will Do**

  


* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end\-to\-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high\-throughput, low\-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade\-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands\-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow\-through improvements

  

**What We're Looking For**


*Technical*

  


* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs \& system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem\-solving ability


*Beyond the technical bar:*

  


* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

  



Nice to Have

  


* Experience building large\-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

description:
Job Summary
  
This hybrid Test Lead role for a global payer focused organization involves owning end to end testing strategy and execution for complex web services and API solutions using Agile methodologies. The Test Lead will coordinate test planning design execution and defect management across SQL based backends and payer domain workflows ensuring high quality releases that enhance member and provider experiences while supporting business growth.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Lead comprehensive test planning activities for payer domain applications by defining clear test objectives scope timelines and resource needs to ensure reliable delivery of high quality features in a hybrid work model.
  
Oversee design of detailed test scenarios and test cases for web services testing and API testing by translating business and technical requirements into robust validation steps that cover functional integration and end to end workflows.
  
Provide direction on using Postman SoapUI and Rest API tools to create execute and maintain automated and manual test suites that validate request response structures status codes and data integrity across environments.
  
Drive execution of API and web services tests with strong SQL based data validation by querying relational databases to confirm data consistency transaction accuracy and proper handling of payer specific rules.
  
Coordinate defect identification triage and retesting by working closely with developers business analysts and product owners to prioritize issues that have the highest impact on member and provider journeys.
  
Guide Agile testing ceremonies such as backlog refinement sprint planning daily standups and sprint reviews by providing risk based testing insights and aligning test efforts with sprint goals and release milestones.
  
Ensure test assets including test cases test data and API collections are structured reusable and well documented to support ongoing regression testing and smooth onboarding of new team members.
  
Collaborate with architecture and development teams to review service contracts payload structures and error handling approaches so that test coverage anticipates edge cases and performance constraints in payer systems.
  
Monitor test progress and quality metrics by preparing concise reports on test execution status defect trends and readiness indicators that support informed release decisions by stakeholders.
  
Implement and refine test processes that improve efficiency and reliability by introducing practical best practices in Agile testing environment usage and data management tailored to payer program needs.
  
Support production readiness and post release validation activities by planning smoke tests health checks and targeted API validations that reduce risk of defects impacting claims processing and customer service.
  
Mentor team members on best practices for API testing SQL validation and web services tools usage by providing constructive feedback and sharing practical examples from payer domain scenarios.
  
Coordinate with cross functional teams in English for both written and spoken communication by ensuring clear documentation issue descriptions and test evidence that facilitate quick understanding and resolution.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Display strong experience in Agile methodologies by applying iterative delivery continuous feedback and collaborative planning techniques throughout the testing lifecycle.
  
Exhibit deep hands on expertise in web services testing and API testing using Postman SoapUI and Rest API tools to validate complex service integrations.
  
Demonstrate advanced SQL skills through the ability to design and execute queries that verify transactional accuracy data transformations and audit trails in payer systems.
  
Bring proven payer domain knowledge by understanding claims flows eligibility checks benefits determination and regulatory constraints relevant to health plan operations.
  
Show capability to work effectively in a hybrid model and day shift by managing time collaboration and coordination across onsite and remote activities without requiring travel.
  
Communicate clearly in English for read write and speak capabilities by producing well structured test documentation and engaging constructively with global stakeholders.
  
  

Certifications Required
  
Preferred certifications include ISTQB Advanced Test Analyst or Certified Agile Tester and any recognized API testing or SQL professional credential.

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, building, and optimizing modern data platforms and pipelines that enable high\-quality, reliable, and accessible data across the organization. You will partner closely with product managers, data stewards, platform engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to develop reusable data capabilities that support analytics, reporting, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and digital products.


Depending on experience and level, you will either contribute to or lead the design and implementation of complex data engineering solutions, influence technical direction, and help establish engineering best practices across the organization.


The ideal candidate is passionate about solving complex data challenges, enjoys building scalable distributed systems, and is highly motivated to create, optimize, or redesign data pipelines to support our next generation of products and data initiatives. Given the highly execution\-focused nature of the work, the ideal candidate will roll up their sleeves to ensure that their projects meet deadlines and will always look for ways to optimize processes in future cycles.


**Core Skills:**

* Demonstrated ability to join a complex global team, collaborate cross functionally (data stewards, data scientists, platform engineers, business stakeholders), and take ownership of major components of the data platform ecosystem and develop data ready tools to support their job.
* Top technical / programming skills – Python, Java and Scala with ability to work across big data frameworks such as Spark, PySpark, Hive, Cloud Data Platforms Preferably Snowflake and SQL.
